messages:
Emma (Support): Heads up — ACME reported a sudden billing spike + intermittent 503s hitting /v1/embeddings after the external audit team ran their checks Wed evening. They asked if this ties to yesterday's audit activity and want audit log retention proof.
Mike (Eng-Sec): Noted. Any repro steps or request IDs from the customer?
Emma (Support): They pasted two request IDs: req_8a3f and req_8a4c. Said errors happened around 21:12 UTC. Also concerned about KMS key rotation they saw in CloudTrail.
Raj (Infra): I pulled the logs for those req IDs — saw retry loop from client side then our gateway returned 502 -> 503 for ~45s. No obvious infra scaling event.
Olivia (Support): Customer also attached an excerpt of CloudTrail showing PutKeyPolicy and GenerateDataKey calls at 21:10. They think the audit runner may have triggered key ops.
Mike (Eng-Sec): Can someone paste the CloudTrail query we should run to correlate?
Ashley (Runtime): Use this snippet to match timestamps and request IDs:```
fields @timestamp, requestParameters, responseElements
| filter eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" and (requestParameters like /GenerateDataKey/ or requestParameters like /RotateKey/)
| filter @timestamp between 2026-11-03T21:00:00Z and 2026-11-03T21:30:00Z
```
Raj (Infra): Ran a tighter query: found a GenerateDataKey* call from auditor IP 52.45.12.99 at 21:09:58 for key alias/redwood-prod-enc. Immediately after we saw a spike in tokenization throughput which stressed a couple of small pods.
Mike (Eng-Sec): So external audit's key ops coincided with increased CPU on runtime and gateway retries. Is this customer-impacting or expected transient load?
Jen (Compliance): From retention side: ACME is asking for audit log retention proof for the last 90 days. We have 365-day retention for KMS events in S3 vault but need to provide a signed export. I'll start packaging exports — what exact time ranges do they want?
Emma (Support): They asked for the entire day of Nov 3 + the 24h around the incident.
Ashley (Runtime): On severity: I think this is P2 — customer production saw errors and billing bump. But the pen/audit team initiated the activity; we need to clarify allowed actions in our contract for dedicated customers.
Mike (Eng-Sec): I argued P3 on initial triage because it was not an infrastructure outage and autoscaling absorbed load within 2 minutes. But since billing spike + app errors, we should escalate.
Jen (Compliance): Severity is for ops; for compliance evidence we'll give logs and key usage. For contract disputes, Legal should weigh in.
Raj (Infra): Action items: 1) Provide ACME with CloudTrail extracts + S3 audit bundle (Jen) 2) Support to confirm refund/credit (Emma/Finance) 3) Eng to add KMS throttling guard rails for auditor IPs and rate-limit GenerateDataKey (Ashley/Raj) 4) Confirm if rolling key rotation could trigger customer errors (Mike).
Emma (Support): ACME asked for repro steps — want a minimal script to reproduce. Can eng provide a safe repro that we can run in a staging tenant?
Ashley (Runtime): Minimal repro: rapid GenerateDataKey calls + simultaneous large embedding requests. Example (staging only):```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST "$STAGING_API/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY" -d '{"input":"lorem ipsum"}' &
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/redwood-staging-enc --key-spec AES_256 &
done
wait
```
Mike (Eng-Sec): Please DO NOT run that in prod. We'll use a rate-limited variant in staging. Also I'll validate whether our KMS client holds locks that could cascade to request processing.
Olivia (Support): ACME wants ETA for evidence and whether we will issue a credit.
Jen (Compliance): Evidence export ETA: 3 business days to prepare signed bundle; can provide raw CloudTrail snippets within 24h.
Emma (Support): Noted. I'll update customer with a 24h snippet promise and 3-day full export. Also opening billing ticket for review.
Raj (Infra): I'll prototype a middleware rate limiter for KMS calls today, push a canary to staging, and report results.
Mike (Eng-Sec): After canary, we should schedule a short post-mortem note and update our security runbook for external audit coordination.
DeployBot: deploy requested by Raj -> staging: infra/kms-rl v1.2.3 (canary)
Ashley (Runtime): Canary looks stable so far, reduced retries on gateway. I'll summarize repro results when complete.
Emma (Support): Thanks—I'll draft message to ACME and loop Legal for any contract language re: third-party audits. :email:
Mike (Eng-Sec): Marking thread for follow-up tomorrow. If anyone gets more customer logs, drop them here. :thumbsup:
